title: encrypt: RSAES-OAEP SPKI cert silently uses PKCS#1v15
description: build_recipient_info() in encrypt.rs checks 'alg_oid == ID_RSAES_OAEP' but routes to build_rsa_recipient() which unconditionally uses Pkcs1v15Encrypt and emits rsaEncryption OID. A cert with id-RSAES-OAEP SPKI would get a PKCS#1v15-wrapped CEK, which the recipient's OAEP decrypt will reject. Fix: return UnsupportedAlgorithm for OAEP SPKI certs, or add a separate build_rsa_oaep_recipient() path. Real-world impact is near-zero (no deployed S/MIME cert uses id-RSAES-OAEP in SPKI), but the code explicitly lists the OID implying intent to support it.
close_reason: Fixed: build_recipient_info() now returns UnsupportedAlgorithm for id-RSAES-OAEP SPKI OIDs instead of silently routing to the PKCS#1v15 path.
